override._why: The main menu (from about 30 s) starts on LOAD GAME, which gives 'Unable to load saved game' with no saves, so Start/A loop between them. Down then A picks NEW GAME (twice, in case the message is up the first time); the defaults then pick GAME 1 and pass the intro into Rainbow Cliffs.
